title: Aero Road Bike Perfection | Scott Foil RC 10 Ride Review

takeaways.text: Aero features include an oversized head tube with a 1-inch steerer section, full internal routing, dropped seatstays and a thin seatpost with a removable light cover.
This Ultegra 8100 RC 10 on the HMX frame weighs 7.9 kg, he says.
After about a week he calls it the fastest road bike he has ridden, very quick out of corners; he steers comfort-seeking riders to the Addict instead.

disclosure: Jenson USA is a retailer selling SCOTT bikes; the review promotes models in stock.
summary: A short retailer ride review of the SCOTT Foil RC 10 with Shimano Ultegra.
